requirements.text: The rating philosophy of each rating system is documented, including the risk drivers that make grade assignment sensitive to current conditions and the expected dynamics of grade migration and grade-level default rates.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD rating systems only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: Non-retail PD rating systems map to the Bank master scale of 20 non-defaulted grades and one default grade.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to non-retail PD rating systems only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: Retail PD rating systems map to the retail master scale of 12 non-defaulted grades (R01–R12) and one default grade, using the PD boundaries of CRM-STD-100 §5.2.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to retail PD rating systems only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: Each grade or pool maps to exactly one master scale grade, and PDs increase monotonically with grade.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD rating systems only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: No non-defaulted grade contains more than 30% of the obligors (non-retail) or exposures (retail) of the rating system unless the concentration is justified and approved by Model Risk Management.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD rating systems only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal threshold authored for the library; the cross-reference to CRR Art. 170(1)(d) for undue grade concentrations should be confirmed against the consolidated CRR text.

requirements.text: The RDS for non-retail PD estimation covers an observation period of at least five years.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to non-retail PD estimation only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text; minimum period consistent with CRR Art. 180(1)(h). Retail PD minimum covered by pilot REQ-D01 (EXT-CRR-IRB).

requirements.text: The RDS for LGD estimation covers an observation period of at least five years for retail exposures and at least seven years for non-retail exposures.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to LGD models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text; minimum periods consistent with CRR Art. 181(1)(j) and 181(2).

requirements.text: The RDS for CCF estimation covers an observation period of at least five years for retail exposures and at least seven years for non-retail exposures.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to EAD/CCF models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text; minimum periods consistent with CRR Art. 182 (paragraph numbering as amended by CRR3 not cited).

requirements.text: Every RDS exclusion is approved by the Model Owner, and the aggregate effect of all exclusions on the long-run average default rate, realised LGD or CCF is quantified and reported.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: A PSI above 0.10 between the RDS and the current portfolio on any risk driver is explained, and a PSI above 0.25 is followed by an assessment of the effect on the estimates.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: External or pooled data is used only where its comparability with the Bank portfolio is demonstrated, including an analysis of differences in the default definition.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: The long list of candidate risk drivers combines statistical analysis and expert input and covers all material drivers of the risk parameter.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: The expected direction of the effect of each risk driver is stated before estimation and confirmed in the final model.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: Discriminatory power (AUC or Gini) is measured on the development sample and on an out-of-time sample and assessed against the thresholds of MV-HB-003.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: Homogeneity within grades and heterogeneity between adjacent grades are tested, and grades that are not statistically distinct are merged or justified.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: PD estimates are calibrated per calibration segment to the long-run average of one-year default rates.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD rating systems only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: One-year default rates are calculated at least quarterly using overlapping one-year windows, and the LRA is their arithmetic average over the observation period.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD rating systems only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: Where the observation period is not representative of the likely range of variability of default rates, the LRA is adjusted upward and the adjustment is documented and justified.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD rating systems only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: Calibration is tested per grade and for the portfolio with a binomial or Jeffreys test against the thresholds of MV-HB-003.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD rating systems only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: LGD is estimated from realised LGDs of all defaults in the RDS, including defaults with incomplete recovery processes for which future recoveries are estimated.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to LGD models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: Realised LGD includes material direct and indirect costs and additional drawings after default, and cash flows are discounted at the primary interbank rate at default plus five percentage points.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to LGD models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text; discount rate consistent with EBA/GL/2017/16 (interbank rate plus 5 percentage points add-on).

requirements.text: The long-run average LGD is calculated as the default-weighted average of realised LGDs over the observation period.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to LGD models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: The downturn period for LGD estimation is identified from the economic factors of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/930, and the downturn LGD is documented per calibration segment.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to LGD models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: Where neither observed nor estimated downturn impact can be derived, the downturn LGD equals the long-run average LGD plus 15 percentage points, capped at 105%.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to LGD models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text; reference-value approach consistent with EBA/GL/2019/03.

requirements.text: ELBE and LGD in-default are estimated per reference date in default, with the difference reflecting unexpected loss during the recovery period.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to LGD models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: Realised CCFs are calculated with a fixed 12-month horizon before the default date, and drawings after default are included in LGD rather than CCF.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to EAD/CCF models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: The long-run average CCF is the default-weighted average of realised CCFs, and final CCF estimates are not negative.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to EAD/CCF models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: CCF estimates reflect economic downturn conditions in accordance with EBA/GL/2019/03.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to EAD/CCF models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: The PD applied to each exposure is at least 0.05%, and at least 0.10% for qualifying revolving retail exposures to revolvers.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to PD rating systems only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text; floors checked against CRR Art. 160(1) and 163(1) as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623.

requirements.text: The LGD applied to retail exposures is at least the input floors of CRR Article 164(4), including 5% for residential property, 50% for QRRE and 30% for other unsecured retail.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to retail LGD models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text; floors checked against CRR Art. 164(4) as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623.

requirements.text: The LGD applied to non-retail exposures with own LGD estimates is at least the input floors of CRR Article 161(5), including 25% for unsecured exposures.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to non-retail LGD models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text; floor checked against CRR Art. 161(5) as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1623.

requirements.text: Floors are applied at exposure level after the MoC and downturn adjustment, and the share of exposures and EAD to which a floor is binding is reported.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IRB models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: Differences between the risk parameters used for own funds requirements and those used for internal purposes are documented and justified.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: Estimates are reviewed when new information comes to light and at least annually, covering back-testing, representativeness, the need for recalibration and the adequacy of the MoC.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.

requirements.text: A red monitoring outcome, or an annual review concluding that estimates are inadequate, leads to a recalibration or redevelopment plan approved by the Model Risk Committee within three months.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard (CRM-STD-100 v5.2) text authored for the library.
